title: Saying What Is Fair, Normal or Strange
goal: Give value judgments about facts and events with impersonal expressions and the subjunctive.

items: I can say what is fair, normal, reasonable or unacceptable with es injusto que, es lógico que and similar expressions.
I can comment on a finished event with a value judgment and haya + participle.
I can use the new words for judging things.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can say what is fair, normal, reasonable or unacceptable with es injusto que, es lógico que and similar expressions.
